scoring.method: Every platform starts at 100 after mandatory file and report checks pass. Points are deducted for documented presentation, proof, parity, or policy weaknesses.

riskLevels.warning: Store guidance conflict or manual review risk

policySources.title: App Review Guidelines 2.3.3
policySources.quote: Screenshots should show the app in use

policySources.title: Screenshot specifications
policySources.quote: You must upload one to ten screenshots

policySources.title: Preview asset requirements
policySources.quote: Screenshots must demonstrate the actual in-app or in-game experience

policySources.title: Large-screen screenshot guidance
policySources.quote: Exclude additional text that is not part of your core app experience

submissionGates.title: Submitted build must match the screenshots
submissionGates.trigger: The store-review build does not contain the shown screens, labels, themes, or app states
submissionGates.outcome: Apple or Google may treat the listing as inaccurate or misleading and reject the metadata or app submission
submissionGates.action: Submit the same tested build lineage used for capture and manually verify every shown feature before upload

submissionGates.title: Text overlays must match the listing locale
submissionGates.trigger: These English marketing panels are reused unchanged in a non-English localized listing
submissionGates.outcome: The listing may remain technically uploadable, but comprehension and promotional eligibility can be reduced
submissionGates.action: Render a translated panel set for every localized storefront that uses translated metadata

strengths: Six primary 1080 x 1920 opaque PNGs meet Google Play's recommended 9:16 promotional format
The first three panels lead with real Saved Trips, live timetable, and parking UI
All marketing claims are concise and supported by visible app functionality

deductions.reason: The first service-alert card is collapsed
deductions.impact: The panel promises service alerts but reveals less alert detail than the tablet and iOS versions
deductions.improvement: Recapture the Android phone screen with the first alert card expanded
deductions.storeRisk: Quality issue only; it is not expected to cause rejection because the visible claim remains accurate

deductions.reason: The Saved Trips parking state differs from newer captures
deductions.impact: Android phone shows Schofields only while the newer device sets show Tallawong and Schofields
deductions.improvement: Recapture Saved Trips with the same parking cards and labels used on tablet and iOS
deductions.storeRisk: Consistency issue only; it does not violate a screenshot requirement

policyReview.title: No current Google Play rejection blocker detected
policyReview.issue: The primary set has valid dimensions, count, opacity, authentic app UI, and no ranking or price claims
policyReview.reviewOutcome: Expected to upload successfully; the two deductions affect proof and consistency rather than policy compliance
policyReview.remediation: Confirm the submitted Android build still contains every shown state and localize overlay copy for other storefront languages

strengths: Seven native tablet captures show the real wide-screen app layout instead of enlarged phone screenshots
All outputs are opaque 1920 x 1080 PNGs with the recommended 16:9 aspect ratio
Saved Trips, expanded live times, parking, expanded alerts, planning, delays, and dark mode form a complete set

deductions.reason: Every tablet panel adds marketing copy outside the captured app UI
deductions.impact: Google warns that extra text on large-screen screenshots can be cut off on Play homepages
deductions.improvement: Keep a UI-only 1920 x 1080 tablet fallback set ready, or test these panels in Play Console before publishing
deductions.storeRisk: Warning, not an automatic rejection; cropping or reduced promotional placement is more likely than listing rejection

policyReview.title: Google large-screen text guidance needs a fallback
policyReview.issue: All seven tablet images include a headline and subline above the native app capture
policyReview.reviewOutcome: The files meet upload specifications, but Play may crop the copy or limit promotional use; a strict review could request replacement assets
policyReview.remediation: Prepare an alternate UI-only 16:9 set before submission and use it if Play Console previewing crops the marketing text

strengths: Seven opaque 1242 x 2688 PNGs use an accepted Apple 6.5-inch screenshot size
Every panel shows the app in use and text overlays are permitted by App Review Guideline 2.3.3
The set includes expanded journey and alert proof plus a genuine dark-mode capture

deductions.reason: The expanded service-alert detail is dense at App Store thumbnail size
deductions.impact: Small alert text is harder to scan before a customer opens the screenshot
deductions.improvement: Use a shorter alert example or increase the app-frame scale while preserving genuine app context
deductions.storeRisk: Conversion issue only; dense genuine UI is not an Apple screenshot rejection reason

policyReview.title: No current Apple screenshot rejection blocker detected
policyReview.issue: The set uses an accepted size, stays within the one-to-ten count, and shows authentic app screens with permitted overlays
policyReview.reviewOutcome: Expected to pass screenshot metadata review if the submitted build matches the captured functionality
policyReview.remediation: Confirm build parity and provide translated artwork for every localized product page

strengths: Seven genuine iPad captures render as opaque 2064 x 2752 PNGs accepted for Apple's 13-inch display
The dual-pane map and detail layout proves native iPad support instead of presenting phone UI
Expanded journey, expanded alert, planning, parking, delays, and dark mode all use the latest app build

deductions.reason: The expanded service-alert detail is dense at App Store thumbnail size
deductions.impact: The long alert body competes with the split-view map when the panel is shown small
deductions.improvement: Capture a shorter expanded alert while retaining the native split-view layout
deductions.storeRisk: Conversion issue only; the screenshot still accurately shows the iPad app in use

policyReview.title: No current Apple screenshot rejection blocker detected
policyReview.issue: The captures are native iPad screens at an accepted 13-inch size and show the app in use
policyReview.reviewOutcome: Expected to pass screenshot metadata review if the submitted iPad build matches these screens
policyReview.remediation: Confirm the App Store build supports iPad and contains the same dual-pane layouts and labels
